title: USB Enumeration Sequence
description: Walks the standard enumeration: detect, reset, read descriptors, assign address, configure. Each step has timeouts and retries; the host learns what the device is before loading a driver. It is the handshake every USB device performs.
key_mechanisms: Detect attach and reset the port

demo.title: Demo — USB Enumeration Sequence

title: Descriptor Parsing
description: Parses device, configuration, interface, and endpoint descriptors to learn capabilities. Malformed descriptors are the classic attack vector, so parsers validate lengths and types strictly. Correct parsing decides which driver binds.

demo.title: Demo — Descriptor Parsing

title: USB-C and Power Delivery
description: Negotiates roles, orientation, and power over USB-C with Power Delivery messaging. The CC lines detect plug orientation and the PD contract sets voltage and current. It unified charging, data, and display on one connector.

demo.title: Demo — USB-C and Power Delivery

title: Mass Storage Class
description: Exposes storage over USB with the Bulk-Only Transport and SCSI command set. The host sends SCSI commands wrapped in USB transfers; the device behaves like a disk. Every flash drive uses it.
key_mechanisms: Present block device to the OS

demo.title: Demo — Mass Storage Class

title: Hotplug Event Handling
description: Delivers attach and detach events to userspace so the system reacts instantly. udev rules mount drives, load firmware, and notify desktops; removal events clean up. It is the OS side of plug and play.

demo.title: Demo — Hotplug Event Handling

title: Safe Removal Protocol
description: Flushes caches and stops the device before physical removal to prevent corruption. Write caching means 'done' is a lie until flush; safe removal makes it true. The OS refuses while handles are open.

demo.title: Demo — Safe Removal Protocol

title: USB Autosuspend
description: Suspends idle USB devices to save power, resuming on activity. The host negotiates suspend with the device and cuts its power budget; resume is transparent. It matters most for battery-powered hosts.

demo.title: Demo — USB Autosuspend

title: Hub Topology Management
description: Manages hub tiers, port power budgets, and transaction translators. Hubs extend the tree up to 7 tiers; the host tracks the topology for power and bandwidth accounting. Bad hubs are a classic source of weird failures.

demo.title: Demo — Hub Topology Management

title: USB On-The-Go
description: Lets dual-role devices negotiate host versus peripheral roles over the ID pin and HNP. A phone becomes the host for a flash drive, then the peripheral for a PC. Role swap modernized this further.

demo.title: Demo — USB On-The-Go

title: UASP Protocol
description: Replaces Bulk-Only Transport with USB Attached SCSI for queued, faster transfers. Command queuing and out-of-order completion lift USB 3 storage to near-SATA speeds. Modern enclosures all use it.

demo.title: Demo — UASP Protocol

title: Device Authorization
description: Authorizes USB devices before they enumerate fully, blocking malicious implants. The host checks device identity against policy; unknown devices get no drivers. It stops BadUSB-style attacks at the port.

demo.title: Demo — Device Authorization

title: Driver Binding
description: Matches drivers to interfaces by class, VID, and PID. The binding layer walks the descriptor tree and loads the right driver per interface; composite devices get several. Correct binding is what makes devices just work.

demo.title: Demo — Driver Binding

title: Speed Negotiation
description: Negotiates the highest mutually supported USB speed at attach. Chirp sequences for High Speed, link training for SuperSpeed; both sides agree before data flows. Fallback keeps old devices working.
key_mechanisms: Agree on the top common speed

demo.title: Demo — Speed Negotiation

title: Composite Devices
description: Handles devices exposing multiple interfaces — a headset with audio plus HID controls. Each interface binds its own driver under one device node. Interface association descriptors group related functions.

demo.title: Demo — Composite Devices

title: DFU Firmware Updates
description: Updates device firmware over USB with the Device Firmware Upgrade class. The device re-enumerates in DFU mode, receives the image, verifies, and swaps. Atomic swap with rollback keeps updates safe.

demo.title: Demo — DFU Firmware Updates
